service.description: Internal, for the SupportCaseRule rules of entity/Request.eecas.xml: ensure#CaseProfile after the commit of the change (at once when there is no transaction), as queue#RequestTriage. A failure is logged, never the change's.

Makes a request a support case when the case rule says it is one (SupportCases.js route): submitted, a Customer party of an organization with a current ServicePolicy that serves it, and in one of its service queues or of a type it service-enables (moved into the type's default queue). Makes the CaseProfile (the policy and workflow, the queue, the intake time and the message it came from) and the OrgInternal party. Idempotent: a case stays one. Internal: run by queue#CaseProfile and create#Case; no permission, so every entry point makes its case.

Whether a request is a support case, with its organization, queue and status category; or, with no requestId, whether a request with the fields given would be one (wouldBeCase), as raise#Request asks before it takes a due date. No permission: it names no customer or record.

A case workflow's current status mappings (agent and customer labels, category, order), the default workflow's for a status it does not map, and its moves (CaseTransition). No permission: workflow labels.

Internal, for the SupportCaseCustomerReply rule of entity/Request.eecas.xml: a message filed on a case from its customer, contact or a contact of the customer organization tells the case's assignee on the topic SupportCaseCustomerReply. Not a case, a note or an internal sender: nothing. A failure is logged.

A case for a customer the organization serves, atomically (design NewCase SubmitCase): the Request (create#Request, Submitted, in a service queue of the organization: the one given, else the type's default, else the policy's), its Customer, Reporter (the contact, when given) and OrgInternal parties, the records it is on (link#RequestRecord), its profile (ensure#CaseProfile) and its assignee. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses a customer it does not serve (CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE), a queue not its (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE) or not taking the type (TYPE_NOT_OFFERED), an assignee outside the queue's team (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE) and an organization with no service policy (SERVICE_NOT_CONFIGURED).

A case's queue, priority and assignee (an empty assigneePartyId unassigns; an absent one leaves it) under its queue (crosscut CaseServiceFacts): another queue of the case's organization (QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE), a priority of 1 to 9, an assignee of the queue's team (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE), told on SupportCaseAssigned. Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, and SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE for a case assigned to another agent; refuses a closed case (CASE_CLOSED) and, with caseRevision, a case changed since (STALE_CASE).

A case's status by its workflow (CaseTransition rows of the profile's workflow, else the default): resolve (Completed or Cancelled) with a resolution when the move needs one (RESOLUTION_REQUIRED), hold, cancel or reopen with a reason (REASON_REQUIRED, written on its conversation), a manager's move (SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE); reopen within the policy's window (REOPEN_WINDOW_PASSED) and never a closed case (CASE_CLOSED). Any other move is refused (TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization; with caseRevision refuses a case changed since (STALE_CASE).

Adds (mode add, the default), removes or replaces a case's tags (RequestTag rows of the RequestTag enumeration; a removed tag is ended). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and the case's organization; refuses an unknown tag (TAG_UNKNOWN).
The in-parameters of a dated settings save.

A service queue (design Queues QueueEdit): its category (a new one owned by the organization, or one already its: QUEUE_ORGANIZATION) with name, parent and responsible party, and a ServiceQueue row from its date: the offered types, visibility (a restricted queue needs its team: TEAM_REQUIRED), responsible team (one of the organization's: TEAM_UNAVAILABLE) and fallback assignee. With end, ends the queue's row (not a queue new intake goes to: QUEUE_IN_USE); its cases stay. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

A request type as the organization offers it for cases (design CaseTypes ServiceTypes), from its date: service-enabled (needs its default queue, a service queue of the organization: QUEUE_REQUIRED, QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE), the customer label, default priority and workflow, and whether the customer pages offer it. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

What a request status means on a case of a workflow (design StatusCategories CaseStatusMap), from its date: the agent's and the customer's labels (LABEL_REQUIRED), the category (CATEGORY_UNKNOWN), whether it needs a reason, and its order. Workflows are shared settings, as status flows are. Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT.

A case workflow (a new one by its description) and, with statusId and toStatusId, one of its moves (design StatusCategories CaseTransitionPolicy) from its date: whether it needs a resolution, a reason or SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE, and whether the customer is told; with end, ends the move. A move must be one of the Default request flow (STATUS_FLOW_MISSING). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT.

An organization's service policy (design ServiceDefaults ServicePolicy) from its date; its first row turns the case rules on for the organization: the default queue (one of its service queues), workflow, what an unknown sender makes, the reopen window (14 days by default, 0 to 365), the auto-close delay, whether resolving needs a resolution, and customerImmediateCancel (off). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.
A service team of the organization: a new one (an organization party it owns, in the OrgTeam role) or one of its renamed (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE). Needs SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT and the organization.

A person joins a service team as an agent (roleTypeId Agent) or its manager (Manager), from a date, by a dated PartyRelationship (PrtServiceTeam); with end, leaves it (the relationship ended, history kept). Needs SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE and to manage the team, or SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT; the team must be one of the user's organizations' (TEAM_UNAVAILABLE) and the member a person (MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE).
